notes: An all-in-one with an ADF and a flatbed scanner. The part numbers are Canon service-part numbers from the 2006 service manual (paper feed motor and the two timing slit films); the power supply unit comes out after one screw and two hooks.

gaps: The manual says it does not give enough information for disassembly and points to a separate Parts Catalog, which is not in this copy. Part numbers are therefore only the ones printed in the service parts table.
The carriage motor and the paper feed motor are named, but no type, voltage or resistance is given for either; the carriage motor has no part number in this manual.
The power supply unit has an AC input range in the machine specification but no output voltages or rating, so no v or w value is set.
The logic board ass'y (QM2-3659) is named, but its chips are not, so no chip is claimed.
The ADF motor is named in the troubleshooting without type or part number, so it is left out.
The timing sensor unit and the feed roller are named without part numbers.
The carriage shaft and its spring appear in a grease table with no size or material.
method: Canon PIXMA MP830 Service Manual (Canon U.S.A., copyright 2006), 85-page PDF from Internet Archive item manualzilla-id-7296295. A user upload, not Canon's own host; the cover and page headers name the PIXMA MP830. The copy prints no document number.

Sections used: maintenance and adjustment tables (1-1, 1-4), customer maintenance, service call error table (2-2), troubleshooting by symptom (2-6), repair (3-1 service parts table, power supply unit removal), adjustments and grease table (3-3), machine and scanner specifications.
The Internet Archive item page was read for the upload details.

comps.spec: Carriage motor, listed among the parts to replace for the carriage error (service call, 2 blinks, code 5100)
Paper feed motor, Canon part QK1-1502 (service parts table); its red screws may be loosened only when the motor unit is replaced
Paper feed motor belt; when the motor is replaced it is positioned so that the belt is stretched tight (adjustment table and paper feed motor adjustment)

Power supply unit, removed by taking out one screw, releasing two hooks, disconnecting two connectors and pulling off the arrester ground wire; the machine specification gives AC 100 to 240 V, 50/60 Hz

Timing slit strip film, Canon QC1-6526 (service parts table); the carriage error (5100) lists a timing slit film, and print enlarged along the carriage movement sends you to clean grease off the strip film; wipe with ethanol if touched, keep grease off
Timing slit disk film, Canon QC1-6229 (service parts table); listed for the line feed error (code 6000); keep grease off, wipe with ethanol and do not bend it
Timing sensor unit, listed among the parts to replace for the line feed error (code 6000)
CCD (charge coupled device) scanner sensor, 2,400 dpi / 600 dpi dual, in the flatbed and ADF scanner (scanner specification)
Carriage shaft: the carriage unit slides along it; the red screws at both ends must not be loosened; the grease table lists Floil KG107A for it
Carriage shaft spring L, named in the grease table and greased with Floil KG107A
Platen glass of the flatbed scanner, cleaned in the scanning area cleaning and named in the document pressure sheet position adjustment
